Why the 76ers had to get creative on opening night</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50229896/lebron-knicks-76ers-thunder-spurs-celtics-pistons</link><description>Brian Windhorst examines a surprising shift for LeBron, plus more takeaways from the NBA's season-opening tripleheader.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 12:50:27 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1021/r1733826_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Victor Wembanyama, Giannis Antetokounmpo lead record African heritage presence in NBA</title><link>https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/50235880/victor-wembanyama-giannis-antetokounmpo-lead-record-african-heritage-presence-nba</link><description>Eighteen African countries are represented in the league, with Nigeria accounting for nearly half the number with 29 players of Nigerian origin.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:31:10 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1021/r1733818_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>BAL to confirm franchises in 2027, but no timeline on new structure - Mark Tatum</title><link>https://www.espn.com/espn/story/_/id/50235597/bal-confirm-franchises-2027-no-line-new-structure-mark-tatum</link><description>NBA Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum said the league plans to announce BAL franchises in 2027, but there is no timeline for a change in the league format.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:22:16 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1021/r1733837_1296x729_16-9.jpg" /></item><item><title>Spurs' Victor Wembanyama misses first 12 shots in rough opener vs. Thunder</title><link>https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/50235327/spurs-victor-wembanyama-misses-first-12-shots-rough-season-opener-vs-thunder</link><description>Victor Wembanyama didn't record his first bucket until the end of the third quarter and shot a career-worst 8% from the field as the Thunder got their revenge on the Spurs in Tuesday's Western Conference finals rematch.</description><pubDate>Wed, 21 Oct 2026 12:25:33 +0000</pubDate><thumbnail url="https://a.espncdn.com/photo/2026/1021/r1733818_600x400_3-2.jpg" /></item></channel></rss>
